Class BaseBankTest

java.lang.Object
ibank.BaseBankTest
public abstract class BaseBankTest extends Object
Inherited JUnit Jupiter tests for the bank assignment. Extend this class in a concrete test class and implement only createBank(). Each call must return a new, independent bank. Run the concrete subclass; this abstract class cannot run on its own. The tests compare monetary values with BigDecimal.compareTo(BigDecimal), so equivalent values such as 0 and 0.00 are accepted.
Author:
JaroslavGr
